Established In Amman, 2016

From Digital Pioneers to Amman’s Flagship Mall Destination

Itba3li (Like Father Like Son) started out with a bold vision: to simplify custom merchandise and bring high-definition printing technology to Jordan. Starting as a beloved online brand in 2016, our relentless commitment to prompt turnaround and exceptional dye-sublimation, screen printing, and laser-engraving led us to launch our premier physical retail store at The Galleria Mall (Level L1) in Amman.

Uncompromising Precision

Color calibration and strict quality assurance make sure your company logo looks razor sharp across every fabric, metal, glass, and ceramic piece.

Express Delivery

From single personalized samples to thousands of corporate giveaways, our Amman workshop handles rush requests with same-day speed.
